name: Rajdeep Chavan
player_statement:
A complete player, Rajdeep Chavan has made a big mark in cricket. With 8 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 18, with an average of 7.43 and a quick strike rate of 104.00. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 3 sixes and 4 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 11.0 overs, taking 7 wickets at an economy rate of 9.18. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
